decisions.reason: Dropping the companion loaders weakens the mining fleet logic, and the trucks were not observed in 2020–2021, but the line is already developed and cheap to hold while underground demand stays uncertain.
A single construction dumper costs little to keep listed and draws on the firm's vehicle know-how, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
The inclined furniture lift line had its own page and forms a coherent lifting family with E and F, so holding it is low-cost while its market potential is still unfolding.
The building material lifts share technology and customers with the furniture lifts, which keeps holding costs low and justifies keeping the option open.
The truck-mounted lift extends the lift family into a mobile variant and was given its own page, and the uncertain early results do not yet justify abandoning it.
